root_cause: ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/single_layer_tests/scatter_elements_update.cpp:176-184) asserts that both the CPU plugin and the TEMPLATE reference plugin throw ov::Exception when ScatterElementsUpdate indices are out of range (e.g. -1000). All 4 parametrized instances of smoke_ScatterElementsUpdateOutOfRangeIndices failed this assertion, indicating the reference/CPU implementation no longer throws for out-of-range indices. This is unrelated to PR #40119, which only touches src/common/transformations/{include,src}/transformations/common_optimizations/fuse_qsa_indexer.{hpp,cpp} and its test file (QSAIndexer partial-RoPE fusion) - a transformation-level change with no relation to the ScatterElementsUpdate op or its CPU/reference kernels. This is the sibling of the already-tracked ScatterUpdate (not ScatterElementsUpdate) Code Issue pattern e746e8e11c0fe156, which has recurred 3+ times with the same 'Expected exception ov::Exception not thrown' symptom on out-of-range indices tests, suggesting a shared underlying regression in how out-of-range index validation/exception-throwing was removed or changed across the ScatterUpdate family of ops.
recommended_actions: Do not block PR #40119's merge on this failure - it is unrelated to the fuse_qsa_indexer transformation change being merged; re-run the failed CPU functional tests job.

Investigate why ScatterElementsUpdate (and the related ScatterUpdate, pattern e746e8e11c0fe156) no longer throws ov::Exception for out-of-range indices in either the CPU plugin or TEMPLATE reference implementation - check recent changes to the scatter op shape/bounds validation or reference kernel.

If the out-of-range-throw behavior was intentionally relaxed, update both test expectations (scatter_elements_update.cpp:183 and scatter_update.cpp:145) to match the new intended behavior instead of expecting an exception.
prevention_strategies: Track this alongside the related ScatterUpdate pattern (e746e8e11c0fe156) as a single cross-cutting regression in out-of-range index handling for the Scatter*Update op family; prioritize a fix given it recurs across unrelated PRs and now has two related signatures in the pattern database.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of the ScatterElementsUpdateOutOfRangeIndices variant (signature_hash 994265a25f80a7b5). A closely related sibling failure, ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (pattern e746e8e11c0fe156, same 'Expected exception ov::Exception not thrown' symptom), has recurred at least 4 times since 2026-10-23 across unrelated PRs (#38825, #39833, #39956 x2), confirming a persistent pre-existing defect in the Scatter*Update out-of-range exception path rather than something newly introduced by this PR.
